findings.location: HTML, final paragraph under “The Imminent Dangers of Deception”
findings.source_quote: “false teachings about ‘casting out’ sin, rather than ‘putting it away’, ‘putting it off ’, or ‘turning away from’ as the Scriptures teach.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «إخراج» with «طرد» to preserve the author's distinction between the false teaching of casting sin out and the scriptural alternatives of putting it away/off or turning away from it. Keep the remaining listed alternatives and HTML structure unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: «إخراج» الخطية، بدلًا من «طرحها» أو «خلعها» أو «الإعراض عنها»، كما تعلّمنا الكتب المقدسة.

findings.location: HTML, final paragraph under “The Imminent Dangers of Deception”
findings.source_quote: “This is the danger of subjective experience becoming our guide in the realm of the spirit”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «الاختبار الذاتي» with «الاختبار الشخصي» or another Arabic rendering that conveys a subjective, personally based experience; «ذاتي» suggests self-examination rather than subjective experience.
findings.translation_quote: هذا هو خطر أن يصبح الاختبار الذاتي دليلنا في عالم الروح

findings.source_quote: “Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate this quoted prose in Arabic, for example: «هنا الحكمة. من له فهم فليحسب عدد الوحش، لأنه عدد إنسان». Preserve the existing tags and reference.
findings.translation_quote: هنا الحكمة. من له فهم فليحسب عدد الوحش، فإنه عدد إنسان

findings.source_quote: “And his number is Six hundred threescore and six”
findings.suggested_fix: Render the number explicitly in Arabic words, e.g. «وعدده ست مئة وستة وستون», rather than leaving the number itself untranslated.
